name: Scandium
occurrence: Widely dispersed in trace amounts across many minerals rather than concentrated in a single ore; genuinely rare and expensive to extract.
majorUses: Aluminium-scandium alloys for aerospace/sports equipment (bike frames, baseball bats)
notableCharacteristics: One of the first elements whose existence and properties Mendeleev predicted in advance (as 'eka-boron') before it was actually discovered.
whyHere: It's the first element to place an electron in a 3d orbital, marking the true start of the d-block and the first transition series.
didYouKnow: Mendeleev predicted scandium's atomic weight and properties years before its discovery, calling the missing element 'eka-boron' — the actual element matched his prediction remarkably closely.
genZNote: Called it before it was cool. Mendeleev predicted this one existed before anyone had actually seen it.
